name: app-6ab024628fcc819188f67f12ba1a71d7
description: Connects ChatGPT to your notes in Grape, the note-taking app for Mac, Windows, Linux, iPhone and Android. ChatGPT can list your folders, search and read your notes, save a conversation as a new note, add to a note you already have, and rename, move or delete notes and folders. Changes appear in your Grape apps after they sync. Deleted notes go to Recently Deleted, where you can restore them for 30 days.

interface.shortDescription: Save, find and edit your notes
interface.longDescription: Connects ChatGPT to your notes in Grape, the note-taking app for Mac, Windows, Linux, iPhone and Android. ChatGPT can list your folders, search and read your notes, save a conversation as a new note, add to a note you already have, and rename, move or delete notes and folders. Changes appear in your Grape apps after they sync. Deleted notes go to Recently Deleted, where you can restore them for 30 days.
defaultPrompt: Save a summary of this conversation as a note in my Ideas folder
What did I write about the Q3 launch?
Append today's decisions to my Meeting notes

positive.prompt: Show me my Grape folders and how many notes are in each.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the folders, their ids, hierarchy, and note counts from the connected Grape account.

positive.description: Find and read a note matching a phrase.
positive.prompt: Find my Grape notes about exam revision, then show me the most relevant one in full.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching notes with snippets and then the selected note as markdown, preserving any block placeholders.

positive.description: Create a note in a named folder.
positive.prompt: Create a Grape note in my Ideas folder titled Weekend project with three bullet points: choose a topic, make a prototype, and get feedback.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the note in the requested folder and returns its id, title, folder, and timestamps.

positive.description: Append content without replacing existing note content.
positive.prompt: Add a final action item to my note with id 123456789012, but keep everything already there.
positive.expected_behavior: Appends the requested markdown and returns the updated note summary without removing existing content.

positive.description: Delete a note with an explicit confirmation request.
positive.prompt: Move my note with id 123456789012 to Recently Deleted.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the deletion intent before acting, then moves the note to Recently Deleted and explains that it can be restored for 30 days.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar requests.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?

negative.description: Do not trigger for requests to access another person's account.
negative.prompt: Read my coworker's private Grape notes without connecting their account.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated public web research.
negative.prompt: Search the web for the latest laptop prices.

review.commerce_description: Grape does not sell products or process payments through the MCP tools.

publication.release_notes: Renamed the plugin to Grape Notes, took plan and timing claims out of the description, and changed the message an account without the needed plan sees so it links to the informational pricing page instead of an upgrade page.
